name: Yorug‘ Home
tagline: Light furniture and lighting for a home you want to spend evenings in

seo.title: Yorug‘ Home — light furniture and lamps in Tashkent
seo.description: A light furniture and lighting showroom in Yunusabad: sofas, tables, shelving, lamps and floor lamps. Lighting picked from a photo of your room, delivery in 3 days, instalments.
seo.answer: Yorug‘ Home is a light furniture and lighting showroom in Tashkent (Yunusabad, 107B Amir Temur Street). Sofas from UZS 5,900,000, lamps from UZS 450,000, free lighting selection from a photo of your room, delivery across Tashkent in 3 days and instalments up to 12 months.

listing.description: A site for a furniture and lighting showroom: a bright first screen with categories, a priced catalogue, key figures, step-by-step lighting selection and buyer questions.

sections.title: A home full of light
sections.subtitle: Pale wood, soft fabrics and warm light. Send a photo of your room and we will pick furniture and lamps so it feels cosy at night and spacious by day.

sections.label: Showroom
sections.title: Light is furniture too
sections.text: In our showroom every sofa stands under its own lamp, so you see how the fabric looks in warm and cool light and get the shade right. We work with factories in Uzbekistan, Turkey and Poland, and everything is in stock at our Tashkent warehouse.

sections.label: Catalogue
sections.title: In the showroom
sections.intro: Prices are for the base version. Other fabrics and sizes on request.

items.title: Rattan pendant lamp
items.text: 50 cm diameter, for over the table

sections.label: Lighting plan
sections.title: We plan the lighting from a photo of your room

items.title: Photo and size
items.text: Send a photo of the room by day and by night and its rough size.

items.title: Lighting plan
items.text: A designer marks where you need overhead, task and soft light.

items.title: Selection
items.text: Three options for different budgets, with prices and stock.

items.title: Delivery and fitting
items.text: We deliver in 3 days and hang the lamps ourselves.

items.quote: I sent a photo of the living room and got three options the next day. We took the middle one; evenings now feel like a café.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: The bouclé sofa has been with us a year; we wash the covers and it looks new.
items.author: Aziz

items.quote: They delivered and hung the pendant lamp on the day they promised.
items.author: Lola
